candidates.explanation: The email-change verification mail builds its link from frontendDomain + '/confirm-email'. That is the same page the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp) uses. The frontend handles that page by calling the sign-up confirmation endpoint (auth/email/confirm). That endpoint expects a sign-up hash, so the email-change hash from AuthService.confirmNewEmail is never applied. The link should point to '/confirm-new-email', which calls auth/email/confirm/new.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
